result.keywords: A hybrid temporal-logic satisfiability problem combines discrete-time constraint satisfaction with explicit finite-trace reasoning, investigating complexity bounds for fragments definable over ordered integer domains and linear-time temporal operators.
result.title: Hybrid Temporal Logic Constraint Checking for Finite and Infinite Traces.
